title: Reduced-round AES-128 key recovery: built, run, certified at r=5; measured cost; r=6 and r=7 outcomes
what_was_built: sq.c, a from-scratch chosen-plaintext key recovery on reduced-round AES-128 using the 4-round integral property, with a partial-sum tail. CLI: ./sq attack5 <keyhex> <rounds> <nstruct> <seed> <threads>.

r5_key_recovery.certificate: recovered key re-encrypts the target plaintexts under an independent implementation sharing no code with the attack

r5_on_a_key_the_producer_never_saw.generated_by: python3 secrets.token_hex(16), by the dispatching session
r5_on_a_key_the_producer_never_saw.why_it_matters: The producer's own runs recovered the FIPS-197 standard test key. A recovery shown only on a well-known constant is weak evidence, because the value could reach the output by a path other than the attack.
r5_on_a_key_the_producer_never_saw.independence: CORROBORATION BY THE DISPATCHING SESSION, NOT INDEPENDENT VALIDATION. Standing basis 0137a051 gives session independence but not model independence.

r6.given: 3 of 4 K6' bytes per diagonal as a hint
r6.reading: The construction does not close at r=6 without hints, and with the stated hint it still leaves survivors on one structure.

r7.given: full K7 plus 3 of 4 K6' bytes per diagonal
r7.THIS_IS_NOT_A_7_ROUND_BREAK: The r=7 run is GIVEN the entire last round key. It recovers four bytes of the preceding key given that. It is a measurement of how far the peeling extends under a hint, and it is NOT a 7-round key recovery. Nothing here claims one.

random_permutation_control.arm: r=10 AES as a stand-in permutation
random_permutation_control.reading: The control fails to produce a unique key and produces empty candidate sets on three bytes, i.e. it is rejected. This is what makes the r=5 unique recovery interpretable.

cost_comparison.reference_basis: 2^128 single-key trials follows from the key length alone and is checkable offline; it is NOT a literature figure
cost_comparison.measured: 25.66 s wall clock for a certified r=5 recovery on the stated machine
cost_comparison.verdict: The measured r=5 cost is below the REF-A definitional reference at r=5 and 128-bit keys.
cost_comparison.WHAT_THIS_IS_NOT: This is not a comparison to published reduced-round cryptanalysis. RQ-AES-003 R3 forbids asserting that comparison in either direction, because this repository has no reachable primary source to adjudicate it. The 4-round integral property this attack uses is not claimed as novel.

scope: AES-128 only, r in {5,6,7}, single key, chosen plaintext, the pinned reduced-round convention (final round drops MixColumns), on one machine. Nothing here is a statement about full-round or deployed AES.

inference.fallback_note: orchestration/model-policies.yaml names a GPT-5.6-family alias that this harness cannot resolve; all roles run model: inherit here.
